title: Open or Closed LLM for Lesser-Resourced Languages? Lessons from Greek
reasoning: The paper benchmarks the performance of Large Language Models on a variety of NLP tasks (such as NER, summarization, translation, and POS tagging) for the Greek language. While it includes a section on 'Ethical considerations' regarding data copyright and privacy, it does not evaluate or benchmark aspects of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
